signin-1-form.alt: The sign-in page with the workspace name and email filled in

overview-1-dashboard.alt: The Overview page: today's calls, who is on a call, and the call volume chart

sip-1-open-phone-system.alt: Phone System in the left menu, then the Connection tab at the top

sip-2-connection-tab.alt: The Connection tab with the Connect your own SIP card and its Add SIP credentials button

sip-3-add-button.alt: Press Add SIP credentials on the Connect your own SIP card

sip-4-empty-form.alt: The Connect your own SIP form before anything is filled in

sip-5-filled-form.alt: The form filled in: label, WebSocket URL, host, SIP username and SIP password

sip-6-save.alt: Press Save credentials at the bottom of the form

sip-7-saved-pending.alt: After saving, the connection shows Saved, not yet registered until the first agent connects

sip-8-connected.alt: A healthy connection shows Connected with a green Active badge

sip-9-failed.alt: A failed connection shows the reason from your provider, here a rejected username or password

sip-10-edit.alt: Edit opens the same form with your details; leave the password blank to keep the current one

page-live-calls.alt: Live Calls: every call in progress, who is waiting and who is free

page-agents.alt: Agents: your team, their status and today's numbers, with the Invite agent button

page-team.alt: Team: assign work and chat with each agent

page-analytics.alt: Analytics: call volume by hour, outcomes and the agent leaderboard

page-campaigns.alt: Campaigns: every campaign with its status, progress and owner

page-sms.alt: SMS: conversations, the bulk sender and your SMS campaigns

page-call-history.alt: Call History: every call with its outcome and length, with an Export log button

page-automations.alt: Automations: missed-call text-back, number rotation and number health

page-billing.alt: Billing: your plan, usage, the Desktop Dialer download and invoices

page-support.alt: Support: send a request to the Kchel team and read replies

campaign-1-create-button.alt: Press Create campaign at the top right of the Campaigns page

campaign-2-choose-type.alt: Choose how the campaign is dialed: Manual dialing for your team, or Voice broadcast to play a recording

campaign-3-manual-form.alt: A manual campaign: name, the contact list, the owner and an optional opening script

campaign-4-broadcast-form.alt: A voice broadcast: the same name and list, plus the recording and the options that control the calls

broadcast-1-row-menu.alt: The three dots at the end of a campaign row open its actions: Start, settings, duplicate and delete

broadcast-2-results.alt: Results and call log for a finished voice broadcast: who heard it, who pressed 1, who asked to stop

contacts-1-buttons.alt: Import CSV loads a whole file at once; Add contact adds one person

contacts-2-import-preview.alt: After choosing a file, match the columns, pick or name a list, and press Preview

agents-1-invite-button.alt: Press Invite agent at the top right of the Agents page

agents-2-invite-form.alt: The invite form: name, email and what the agent may do

agents-3-card-menu.alt: The three dots on an agent's card: status, Assign task, Message, What they can do, Turn access off

ivr-1-add-option-button.alt: Under Keypress routing, press Add option

ivr-2-option-form.alt: The keypress option form: Key, Label, Action and Target

ext-2-form.alt: The extension form: Number, Label, Type and Forwards to

billing-1-compare-button.alt: Press Compare plans at the top right of Billing

billing-2-plans.alt: The plan comparison: each plan's price, limits and what it includes

smart-1-open-options.alt: Open the three dots on a voice broadcast and choose Recording and options

smart-2-options-top.alt: The Recording and options form: the recording, voicemail handling and the keys a person can press

smart-3-calling-hours.alt: When calls are placed: only call during set hours, the days, and whose clock to use

smart-4-retries.alt: Try again, Call from and Text follow-up: retries, which number people see, and a text for the people who respond

smart-5-follow-up.alt: Text follow-up: who gets the text and what it says, plus how many people are rung at the same time
